title: GitHub Runner Manager
tagline: Web GUI & Container Supervisor for GitHub Actions Self-Hosted Runners
description:
Full-stack Web GUI and Docker container manager for GitHub Actions self-hosted runners. Easily provision, monitor, control, and update multiple GitHub runner instances from a high-performance web dashboard.

### Features
- Multi-runner lifecycle management with live telemetry.
- Docker-in-Docker workflow execution with dedicated storage mounts.
- Persistent runner diagnostics, workflow log tracking, and token locking.
author: kerklangsi
release_notes:
### What's New in v4.0.0
- Major release upgrade with decomposed CI/CD pipelines (Validate, Release, Docker Publish).
- Multi-arch Docker Hub automated publishing (linux/amd64, linux/arm64).
- Unified single cache volume and dedicated shared data storage.

tips.info: Ensure port 3000 is not in use before installing.
